rics.meaning: Gross National Product (GNP) — GDP plus net foreign factor income (factor receipts from abroad minus factor payments to abroad). Indonesia's GNP runs slightly below GDP because of net outflow of factor income (FDI dividends, debt-service payments).
rics.how_to_use: GNP-to-GDP gap measures the 'foreign income drain'. Indonesia's gap (-$25B/year) reflects FDI dividend repatriation and external debt service. The gap widens during commodity booms (more FDI profits to repatriate).
